eas_text: A civil authority has issued A LOCAL AREA EMERGENCY for the following counties or areas: San Diego, CA; at 8:29 PM on AUG 19, 2023 Effective until 8:44 PM. Message from WSLF/CAP.
extra_text: County OES: Tropical Storm Warning-Dangerous flash flooding and strong winds are expected. Do not travel unless you must, avoid flooded roads, avoid downed power lines, and stay away from waterways and low-lying areas. Follow guidance from your local public safety officials. More information at www.AlertSanDiego.org
